authorship.baseline_prompt_en: A photographic portrait of an adult woman, using the supplied portrait for visible face and hair, on a secluded waterfront restaurant garden terrace at blue hour. Her short dark bob frames her recognizable facial features. A warm wall lantern and a soft band of river light describe the outdoor place; the restaurant's open glass door glows several steps behind her. She sits at one end of a low stone bench with a deep charcoal cushion, the near half of the bench left open toward the camera. She waits in anticipation of the viewer joining her. Both hips rest on the seat, knees held together at an oblique angle, both feet resting on the paving. One hand lies palm down on the cushion beside her hip; the other rests lightly on her own knee. She wears a deep burgundy silk slip dress with fine straps and a soft cowl neckline, its fluid fabric settling around her seated legs. Her shoulders turn toward the viewer and her chin lowers slightly. She holds direct eye contact, with a small asymmetric smile and gently parted lips. She meets the viewer with unhurried desire in her eyes: a seductive invitation to approach. The open place, still hands, and held gaze make her patient anticipation the photograph's leading attraction. Photograph from her seated eye level at close conversational distance, including her head, shoes and the open half of the bench. The warm lantern softly models her cheek and the silk; cool twilight gives the river and garden a quiet depth. The background is softly resolved while her face, seated body and inviting empty place remain legible.
